description: InterDrift Audit Rules: Indian Domestic Payment Rails & Statutory Fee Slabs

rules.description: Standard bank account UPI transactions must incur 0% MDR
rules.source_citation: Finance Act 2019 / Section 10A PSS Act 2007 (effective 1 Jan 2020)
rules.confidence_note: Legally verified. All P2M bank-to-bank UPI transfers carry statutory zero-MDR mandate.

rules.description: RuPay domestic debit card transactions must incur 0% MDR
rules.source_citation: Section 10A Payment and Settlement Systems Act (Ministry of Finance, 2020)
rules.confidence_note: Legally verified. Zero MDR applies unconditionally to all domestic RuPay debit cards.

rules.description: RuPay credit card on UPI transactions up to Rs 2,000 must incur 0% MDR
rules.confidence_note: Verified. Small merchant & low-ticket RuPay credit transactions up to Rs 2000 are zero-rated.

rules.description: RuPay credit card on UPI transactions over Rs 2,000 incur tiered interchange (approx 1.5% - 2.0%)
rules.source_citation: Canara Bank Merchant Circular / NPCI framework (June 2026 update)
rules.confidence_note: Interchange slab is verified (>Rs 2000 chargeable), but specific MCC tiering is modeled at 1.5%.

rules.description: PPI wallet on UPI transactions up to Rs 2,000 carry zero interchange
rules.confidence_note: Verified. Standard wallet-on-UPI below Rs 2000 carries no merchant interchange.

rules.description: PPI wallet on UPI over Rs 2,000 for Education and Utilities capped at 0.70%
rules.confidence_note: Verified. Special MCC concessions define 0.70% for education and utilities.

rules.description: PPI wallet on UPI over Rs 2,000 for Standard Retail/Supermarkets capped at 0.90%
rules.confidence_note: Verified. Supermarket MCC attracts 0.90% interchange under the April 2023 circular.

rules.description: PPI wallet on UPI over Rs 2,000 for General B2B/Commercial capped at 1.10%
rules.confidence_note: Verified. Default maximum interchange ceiling for commercial merchants is 1.10%.

rules.description: Visa/Mastercard debit for small merchants (turnover <= Rs 20L) capped at 0.40% or max Rs 200
rules.confidence_note: Verified statutory ceiling. Per-transaction fee cannot exceed Rs 200.

rules.description: Visa/Mastercard debit for large merchants (turnover > Rs 20L) capped at 0.90% or max Rs 1,000
rules.confidence_note: Verified statutory ceiling. Cap applies immediately at ticket values >= Rs 1,11,111.

rules.description: Visa/Mastercard retail credit cards checked against contracted flat rate (approx 2.0%)
rules.source_citation: Standard Indian Merchant Service Agreement market benchmarks
rules.confidence_note: Credit card interchange is unregulated in India; comparison is against contracted MSA rate.

rules.description: Corporate card surcharge triggered by missing L2/L3 commercial data fields
rules.source_citation: Modeled B2B payment gateway data qualification standards
rules.confidence_note: Global mechanism modeled for domestic B2B acceptance. Missing PO/Tax data incurs 80 bps penalty.

rules.description: Batch-level structural leakage: Contracted flat 2.0% MDR charged over actual low-tier interchange cost
rules.confidence_note: Evaluated at batch aggregate level, quantifying excess margin absorbed by payment aggregator.

rules.description: Merchant business type misclassified to a higher-rate interchange category
rules.confidence_note: Flags transactions processed under grocery MCC 5411 instead of registered B2B wholesale 5045.

rules.description: Detection flag: High-cost credit rail used where lower-cost domestic debit/bank rail was available
rules.confidence_note: Advisory flag for reporting dashboard. Highlights potential fee savings without altering transaction flow.
